items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment and reject candidate-plan dispatch, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, and new spend this cycle. Revenue evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The $4.92 cannot be assigned to sites; reported site-attributed commission of $0 does not prove zero site performance. AI usage covers 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27: 4,892 calls, $890.42 cost, 225 errors, and 5 transient errors. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost periods are not aligned, infrastructure/domain/labor/marketing/experiment costs are incomplete, monthly budget ceilings are blank, and no learning-outcome threshold exists. The treatment pilot's 70 outputs versus 44 controls is operational activity, not financial or causal evidence; treatment also had 58 requests versus 40, 7 failures versus 7, and a 12.21-hour average cycle versus 9.39 hours. Continue only existing reconciliation, repair, validation, legal, security, and measurement work using recorded telemetry.

Retain the candidate SEO, UX, affiliate, site-factory, control-plane, and content-normalization ideas as deferred hypotheses only. Do not create duplicate finance work or dispatch the proposed change requests. The minimum finance evidence is already assigned to the existing measurement and attribution reconciliation work item: reconcile provider revenue to site/content/tracking identifiers for the same period as costs, preserve aggregate commission as unattributed, and retain margin, ROI, payback, causal lift, budget capacity, and cost-to-learn as unknown until the required ledger and thresholds exist.

Maintain financial containment. Do not claim site revenue, ROI, margin, payback, causal lift, budget capacity, or cost-to-learn. Preserve the provider-aggregate commission as unattributed and continue the existing period-aligned reconciliation work only.
